name: The Ump Show
detailed_description:
Take control of the game as a baseball umpire. Make accurate calls but make sure your team wins!

Pitchers will change up the pitch selection to confuse the batters but you have to be better. Track fastballs and breaking pitches to make accurate strike/ball calls. If you make a terrible call, the players will challenge your call! If you make too many wrong calls, it's game over!

Calls you will make as the home plate umpire:
  • Ball/Strike
  • Checked swings
  • Fair/Foul
  • Tag Plays and Forceouts

Since you want your preferred team to win, remember to cheat! Giving up too many walks or too many balls can give away the game. Pick your moments and redirect the game at the right time.

To help you, you can spend your integrity to purchase powerups!

  • Block: Stop a player from challenging your call
  • Balk: Call a balk on the pitcher and immediately reward a walk to the batter
  • Eject: Replace the batter or pitcher with your preferred player.

Story Mode


You start as an umpire with no credibility in the amateur leagues. Your goal is to build credibility and earn favors to climb your way to umpiring at the highest levels!

English*, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
